The two are one decision -- with codegen deferred mwccarm lays .text down in reverse source order and an out-of-line destructor emits D2, D0, D1; with it off the file emits in source order and the destructor emits D1, D0, D2, which is the cartridge's D1 (0x02111688) below D0 (0x021116d0). Measured: verify reports all 44 sections in ROM-ascending order.

The class is written under the cartridge's RTTI spelling, daMky_c, not the tree's former coined `Ukiki`; the rename landed as its own commit ahead of this one. A coined name makes that record homeless and both dispositions refuse it -- the wall ov071/Scuttlebug hit.

STAGE 3b, what converted: 20 of the 44 members are real daMky_c:: methods. Nine were already C++-named when the shards were gathered (the whole virtual interface: ~daMky_c and the seven overrides). Eleven more were converted in this pass -- EnterState0..EnterState10, at 0x02114124, 0x02113fd8, 0x02113be8, 0x02113a80, 0x0211360c, 0x021132d4, 0x02112ff8, 0x02112c14, 0x02112a14, 0x02112560 and 0x021123a4. STAGE 3b, why those eleven and not more. Member-ness is ROM-proven for 22 of the 35 free functions: they are the targets of the 22 pointer-to-member records at 0x02115ac8. A number is ROM-proven for eleven of those 22. Each of the eleven writes exactly one immediate to the state word at +0x3b4, and across all 44 functions the values are 0,1,2,...,10 -- none repeated, none missing -- while 0x02115e0c holds exactly 11 descriptors of 0x10 bytes. Eleven handlers, eleven descriptors, eleven consecutive ids is a bijection. func_ov030_021141a8(this, N) stores &data_ov030_02115e0c[N] at +0x3a4 and calls func_ov030_02114170, which invokes pp[0]; 021141a8 never touches +0x3b4 itself, so the body that wrote N is descriptor N's pp[0]. The other eleven records write no state id, which is the 11 x (entry, tick) split the 0x10 descriptor predicts -- but the ARRAY ORDER does not pair them (2i, 2i+1): records 4 and 5 are both entry handlers. Which tick belongs to which entry is still unproven and no name here asserts it.

STAGE 3b, which wall stops the other 24. NOT codegen and NOT scope -- both were measured absent before any of this was written. Probe 1 converted three declaration-free members and probe 2 a declaration-carrying one, forcing its declarations to file scope above three members that redeclare the same symbol with a different return type; all four still byte-matched, and the eleven real conversions then landed 44/44 at the first compile that got past a type error. The wall is NAMING. Eleven of the 24 are pointer-to-member targets whose member-ness is proven but which the ROM neither names nor numbers; the other thirteen are not proven members at all. A coined name with no evidence behind it is worth less than the address, so they stay free functions.

STAGE 3b, the cost of converting members that are NOT at the end of the file. A C++-named member cannot carry a linkage specification, so its declarations must sit at file scope above it -- and because this TU is laid out ROM-ascending, the eleven EnterState* members are scattered among the free functions and their region has to go at the TOP. That puts 12 canonical function declarations in view of all 24 free functions below, several of which recovered the same symbol differently at block scope. Measured: mwccarm 2004/b56 accepts that for FUNCTIONS (a block-scope redeclaration inherits the visible C linkage, and with -gccext,on the differing spellings do not collide) and rejects it outright for DATA -- hoisting data_ov030_02115ce0 / _02115d08 / _02115d18 / data_02082214 gave `identifier 'data_ov030_02115d18' redeclared; was declared as 'int[]', now declared as 'void *[]'`, the same wall that keeps decl_common.h out. Data does not need hoisting: a global-scope variable is not mangled, so an `extern int data_ov030_02115ce0[];` written at block scope inside a C++-named member still resolves to the plain symbol. Every member kept its own data declarations. Two call sites were retyped to the canonical function spelling (EnterState4's SetAnim second argument, EnterState3's SetAnim receiver and file argument); both pass the same value in the same register and cost nothing.

STAGE 3b, the member rename must land WITH the promotion, and that is measured rather than quoted. The eleven renames were written into config/arm9/overlays/ov030/symbols.txt while the shards were still unpromoted, and the linkcheck BASELINE control -- which builds the tree with no TU substitution -- went from green to `modules NOT byte-exact: ['ov030']` with 11 `Symbol '_ZN7daMky_c11EnterStateNEv' ... not found in linked binary / Possible name: func_ov030_XXXXXXXX` errors. The 22 pointer-to-member records at 0x02115ac8 are unowned .data that dsd resolves by NAME, so a half-landed rename links them as 0x00000000. symbols.txt, the TU and this manifest therefore move in one commit.
